teaser: My 2018 book for young developers, 60% done, much of it outlines since written here as articles, and a plan for a second edition.
core_idea: Generation Z Developers (2018) holds much of what the newsroom now argues, mostly as outlines (90 of 138 files) that have since been written as articles, so a second edition can keep the title, finish the outlines from the articles, say what did not hold, add handwritten notes, and be published on KDP, possibly launched in Portugal, as a manual for getting into development and getting a job.
